title: TTwin question pack item
description: Shipped per-item contract. A complete TTwin question keeps five-click tags (pack, subject, big_idea_id, chapter_id, subtopic_id), learner stem/options/figures, and under assessment: extracted examiner comments where available (never invented), learn-by-solve follow-ups for every wrong MCQ option when a key is available, and Mx-library modify seeds for T-MOD. Mix-up type names are teacher-key only. Frozen exam.v1 is not rewritten. Join key is uid (bare item_uid, never tm:).

uid.description: Bare item_uid join key, e.g. 9701_m16_qp_12:q1. Never tm:-prefixed.

figure_src.description: Pack-time original exam crop (relative PNG). Preferred over tikz for 9701 spectroscopy learner/teacher papers.

assessment.description: Teacher-only. Learner renderer must not descend here.

learn_by_solve.description: ISO-GEN LBS overlay. Spec = packed hinge + that option’s failure mode (intermediate step or V2 mx). Follow-up is a simpler question on that gate (true/false, multi-select, assertion–reason, match, fill-blank with a term bank, or single MCQ). why explains the hint only. Learner renderer must not print mx_type or the original key on the hint. Submitting the hint returns the student to the original unaided.

modify_seeds.description: Teacher-only T-MOD instruction stubs derived from the Mx library (V2 types). Session-only modify; no new freeze uid. Never printed on the learner paper.
